name: environmental
description: URL plan + content map template for environmental testing and solutions companies (mold inspection/testing, indoor air quality, asbestos, lead, radon, water quality, clearance testing, environmental site assessments, compliance, remediation oversight). Mixes local-health appointment intent (mold and air testing) with B2B due-diligence intent (ESAs, compliance, oversight) and dense city x service cross-product pages.
recommended_certifications: Cal/OSHA Certified Asbestos Consultant (CAC) or Site Surveillance Technician (CSST)
notes: Environmental testing is a split-intent vertical: residential testing (mold, air quality, radon) is local_health appointment intent from worried homeowners and real-estate transactions; ESAs, compliance, and oversight are local_b2b due-diligence intent. Only sewage contamination assessment and post-flood mold assessment carry local_emergency intent. Plan defaults reflect the mix.
Cross-product pages (/service-areas/{city}/{service}/) are the primary SEO lever in this vertical and are enabled by default.

INDEPENDENCE POSITIONING (the vertical's core differentiator): the client is an independent tester, not the remediation contractor. Copy leads with conflict-of-interest-free credibility: they don't profit from finding problems, their reports are contractor-neutral, and clearance testing verifies someone ELSE's remediation work. Never describe the client as a restoration or remediation company, and never imply they perform cleanup/abatement/repairs unless the client's own record explicitly says so.

Remediation referrals: when a client discloses a related remediation company via the OPTIONAL brand.sister_company field ({name, url, relationship}), content may reference it with disclosed framing and MUST also disclose how independence is preserved. When absent, never invent one — end at the testing scope plus neutral advice to hire a qualified, unaffiliated remediation contractor. See linking-rules.json sister_company_policy.

24/7 / after-hours claims are gated on brand.hours exactly as in the restoration vertical, and this vertical's archetype defaults deliberately carry NO 24/7 phrasing at all: testing is scheduled work. Urgency copy is allowed only on the two local_emergency services and still respects brand.hours.

Health-claims guardrail: testing content discusses asbestos, lead, radon, mold, and sewage pathogens. Never diagnose, never promise health outcomes, never fear-monger. Cite exposure guidance to the EPA/CDC/state agency and keep the tone clinical and calm. content_guardrails='sensitive' services additionally trigger Skill 3's sensitive-content rules at generation time.
